summary: A 6-core desktop processor built for fast, efficient everyday performance.

features.title: Hybrid-ready platform
features.text: Pair with 600- or 700-series Intel boards and DDR4 or DDR5 memory.

features.title: Power limits
features.text: Check your board’s PL1 and PL2 values if sustained performance matters.

guides.title: Install the CPU
steps: Open the LGA1700 socket arm.
Align the triangle on the processor with the socket marker.
Lower the load plate and lock the arm.

summary: A gaming-focused 8-core processor with extra cache for high frame rates.

features.title: 3D V-Cache
features.text: The stacked cache is tuned for game engines that benefit from low-latency access.

features.title: Curve Optimizer
features.text: Use a conservative negative curve to explore lower temperatures without losing boost.

guides.title: Choose a cooler
steps: Use a capable tower or 240 mm liquid cooler.
Update the AM5 board BIOS before tuning.
Run a repeatable game or CPU benchmark after each change.

summary: A balanced Ada Lovelace graphics card for high-refresh 1440p play.

features.title: DLSS 3 frame generation
features.text: Enable it in supported titles when you want more perceived smoothness.

features.title: Resizable BAR
features.text: Turn it on in firmware and your graphics driver for better asset access.

guides.title: Install the card
steps: Remove two rear expansion slot covers.
Seat the card until the retention clip clicks.
Connect the recommended power lead before closing the case.

summary: A flagship 4K graphics card with massive raster and ray-tracing headroom.

features.title: Four-slot clearance
features.text: Measure the case and adjacent expansion slots before ordering.

features.title: Power connector care
features.text: Fully seat the 12VHPWR cable with no sharp bend near the plug.

guides.title: Check the build
steps: Confirm the PSU has enough continuous capacity.
Measure GPU length and thickness against the case.
Connect the cable straight and verify the latch is engaged.

summary: A PCIe 4.0 NVMe drive designed for fast desktop and workstation storage.

features.title: Heatsink fit
features.text: Use the motherboard heatsink or the drive’s heatsink version, not both.

guides.title: Install the drive
steps: Find the top M.2 slot connected to the CPU.
Slide the drive in at an angle.
Secure it flat and replace the heatsink.

summary: A matched memory kit for modern Intel and AMD desktop platforms.

features.title: Enable the profile
features.text: Select XMP or EXPO in firmware to use the advertised speed.

guides.title: Seat the kit
steps: Open the latches on the paired slots.
Align the notch and press evenly until both latches close.
Boot once, then enable the memory profile.

summary: An AM5 board with PCIe 5.0 expansion, Wi-Fi 6E, and a strong power stage.

features.title: BIOS FlashBack
features.text: Update firmware from a USB drive without installing a CPU.

guides.title: First boot
steps: Connect the 24-pin and CPU power leads.
Install one memory stick for a minimal POST test.
Update BIOS before enabling tuning profiles.

summary: A dual-tower air cooler known for quiet operation and broad compatibility.

features.title: Check RAM clearance
features.text: Raise the front fan or use low-profile memory for tight cases.

guides.title: Mount it evenly
steps: Install the platform-specific backplate.
Tighten each spring screw a few turns in rotation.
Clip fans on after checking RAM clearance.

summary: A fully modular 80 PLUS Gold power supply for balanced gaming builds.

features.title: Use the right cable
features.text: Only use cables supplied for this exact PSU family.

guides.title: Cable the system
steps: Install the PSU with the fan facing ventilation.
Connect motherboard and CPU power first.
Add only the modular leads your components need.

summary: A wired gaming mouse with a high-resolution HERO sensor and programmable controls.

features.title: DPI shift
features.text: Hold the thumb sniper button to temporarily switch to a lower sensitivity.

guides.title: Tune the mouse
steps: Install Logitech G HUB if needed.
Set a primary DPI and one lower shift value.
Save the profile to onboard memory when traveling.

summary: A full-size mechanical keyboard with dedicated controls and per-key lighting.

features.title: Media controls
features.text: Use the dedicated dial and media keys to adjust playback without leaving a game.

guides.title: Set a profile
steps: Open Synapse and select the keyboard.
Assign lighting and macros by application.
Export a backup of the profile when complete.

summary: A 27-inch QHD high-refresh monitor tuned for responsive gaming.

features.title: Motion mode
features.text: Use the highest stable refresh rate and enable adaptive sync in both menu and driver.

guides.title: Connect correctly
steps: Use DisplayPort for the full refresh range.
Set the display to 165 Hz in the operating system.
Enable adaptive sync in the GPU control panel.

summary: A compact PCIe NVMe drive for everyday desktops and laptops.

features.title: Slot compatibility
features.text: It can operate in compatible PCIe 3.0 slots at lower link speed.

guides.title: Move your install
steps: Initialize the drive in your operating system.
Clone or install to the new volume.
Confirm boot order after restarting.

summary: A high-performance PCIe 4.0 gaming SSD with optional dashboard tools.

features.title: Game Mode 2.0
features.text: Use the dashboard to tune background behavior for game-focused workloads.

guides.title: Keep it cool
steps: Install under a motherboard heatsink when possible.
Leave airflow around the controller area.
Check drive temperature during long transfers.

summary: A low-latency DDR5 kit with a sculpted heat spreader and profile support.

features.title: Validate stability
features.text: Run a memory test after enabling XMP before trusting a new overclock.

guides.title: Install the kit
steps: Use the board’s recommended paired slots.
Seat both modules until the latches lock.
Enable XMP and validate in a memory test.

summary: A spacious airflow case with a clean interior and generous radiator support.

features.title: Front mesh path
features.text: Use intake fans at the front and exhaust at the rear or top for a simple pressure balance.

guides.title: Plan airflow
steps: Mount intake fans behind the front mesh.
Route cables through the rear channel.
Keep the GPU intake area clear of loose cables.

summary: A compact aluminum mechanical keyboard with wireless and wired modes.

features.title: Switch modes
features.text: Use the side toggle to switch between Bluetooth, cable, and off positions.

guides.title: Pair it
steps: Move the toggle to Bluetooth.
Hold the selected device shortcut.
Choose the keyboard from your host’s Bluetooth menu.
